'''Quarlo Bridin''' was a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] wanted in several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] for influence selling and corruption. Fleeing to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bridin Anchorage|Gallienis IV]], he convinced the local population that he could use his influence with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to protect them. In truth, Bridin had no contacts with the Empire, and used the situation surrounding the [[Imperial Civil War]] to make good on his promise. At the same time, he used the threat of turning the planet over to the Empire to keep the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] at bay. However, Bridin was aware that his deceit might not last and cut a deal with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]]. In exchange for [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] technology, the Hutts gained a foothold in the sector.
